name: Bunk pod with privacy shutter
brief: MK-070 Bunk pod: two stacked sleep capsules, Daddy's up top and Abbie's below. Round 2, matched to the pick: each capsule is a chunky framed module with an open side showing a blue mattress, pillow and warm reading lamp, a slatted shutter beside it, an orange window at the head end and an amber ladder. Diegetic: a closed shutter with the lamp off means someone is asleep.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
